script.text: An ancient kingdom. A forbidden game. A young prince with one night of freedom.
Beyond the palace walls, the festival is beginning. Before you can slip away, an old adviser steps into the courtyard.
I know that look. You have already chosen the gate with the sleepiest guards.
Only a short visit to the village. I will return before dawn.
Then indulge an old man first. A duel can teach you when to be bold and when to protect what matters.
Defeat Simon Muran. This recreation uses current card rules: strong monsters may need Tributes, and Traps must be set before they can be used.
